topic.source_contract: Water-supply, sewerage, treatment-capacity, DWMP, WRMP and connection evidence

facts.planning: adequate water and wastewater infrastructure supports sustainable development
facts.drainage: public foul sewer is the first presumption where practicable
facts.guard: planning permission and sewer connection/capacity approvals are separate

facts.purpose: integrated evidence on supply, wastewater, water quality and growth
facts.guard: study-level capacity is not a site connection confirmation

facts.WRMP: secure sustainable supply planning with demand, uncertainty and environment
facts.guard: company plan options are not delivered site capacity

facts.capacity: network, treatment works, rainfall and climate pressures considered
facts.guard: DWMP is not a developer connection offer

facts.connections: developer and self-lay routes for new water and wastewater connections
facts.guard: service measures and market routes do not prove site-specific capacity

scope_guards: A WRMP is not treated as a site-level connection offer.
A DWMP is not treated as evidence that a specific reinforcement is funded or complete.
Planning permission is not treated as water or sewer connection approval.
Public-sewer capacity concerns do not automatically justify a private discharge.
Network capacity and wastewater-treatment permit headroom are kept separate.
Surface-water and foul-water systems are not conflated.
Planned infrastructure is not treated as available before delivery and commissioning.
No score or promotion is written without exact provider, zone, network, works, permits, offer and phasing evidence.
